Title: Randomized controlled multicenter trial on the effectiveness of the collagen hemostat Sangustop® compared with a carrier-bound fibrin sealant during liver resection (ESSCALIVER study, NCT00918619)
Author: Moench et al.
Comment: The paper reports 128 patients as intraoperatively randomized, but one patient was excluded before hemostat application because the resection area was dry. Mortality counts are therefore paired with the explicitly reported treated/evaluable population (COLL 62; CBFS 65), not all 128 randomized participants. No mortality risk ratio or mortality-specific confidence interval was reported, so none was entered. In the planned synthesis, the fibrin-based risk is group 2 and the non-fibrin comparator risk is group 1.
Design Type: Prospective multicenter two-arm randomized single-blinded noninferiority trial
Study Environment: Eight high-volume surgical centers; elective open liver resection
Participant type: Adults aged over 18 years undergoing elective open liver resection
Outcome measurement: Death from any cause during the 3-month study follow-up
effect_direction: RR > 1 indicates more deaths with the fibrin-based agent

Author: Seoung Hoon Kim et al.
Comment: The Results state only that no deaths were reported overall, while randomization was 45 per group. Zero deaths are assigned to each arm because the statement covers the full randomized trial population. Title: A Randomized Clinical Trial Comparing the Effect of Different Haemostatic Agents for Haemostasis of the Liver after Hepatic Resection
Comment: The paper states that no death occurred during the study period but does not define the exact follow-up interval. Zero deaths were assigned to each randomized arm from this trial-wide statement. Surgicel (n=15) and Glubran 2 (n=15) were combined as the eligible non-fibrin comparator (n=30). This double-zero study is descriptively relevant but non-informative for a conventional risk ratio; no RR or confidence interval was reported or calculated.
